uncited: It differs from [Naive Voxel Meshing](2376-naive-voxel-meshing.md) by actively checking neighbor states to suppress redundant geometry, and from [Face Culling Voxel Meshing](2268-face-culling-voxel-meshing.md) by serving as the foundational algorithmic family from which specific culling implementations are derived.
**Culling Logic**: A face is generated if and only if the neighbor is empty (or outside the chunk, depending on boundary policy).
It iterates over voxel, context, and transform tuples, builds shared vertex data, and appends the voxel to the triangulation.
